significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the conclusion that a residual-stream quantity—the "commit vector" projection—predicts when an answer will remain stable, while adding or ablating that direction respectively accelerates or delays commitment; this combines a form-(iii) predictive coupling with a form-(ii) causal claim. It would establish both a phenomenon (answers are often internally settled before the chain of thought ends) and a mechanism for one behavior, constraining where redundant reasoning begins and supporting decisions about when generation can stop; CALM (Schuster et al., NeurIPS 2022) and s1 (Muennighoff et al., 2025) illustrate that reliable adaptive-compute signals and stopping policies are consequential to efficiency. Refutation would informatively reject a simple low-dimensional linear causal commitment state, though the claim itself concedes that nonlinear commitment or ordinary confidence could remain, and true versus false are therefore distinguishable states. In the topic-substitution check, generic mechanistic work on efficient reasoning would not retain this score after removing the claimed projection–stability coupling and bidirectional causal effect; nevertheless, the familiar direction-plus-steering shape keeps the increment moderate rather than field-defining.

reach.justification: The concrete handle is a threshold on the "commit-vector projection" used by an "early-exit controller," and it is ex ante because it is claimed to identify the "earliest safe exit point" before the remaining reasoning tokens are generated. Its immediate users could include inference-system practitioners who gate or ship reasoning models, not only interpretability researchers, and the asserted application spans "math, logic, and code" and model sizes. After per-model re-extraction, the projection-to-answer-stability relation would still predict safe stopping on new instances, but the claim does not firmly assert that either the vector or calibrated threshold transfers across architectures—it merely says it is "asking whether the direction is shared"—so broad transfer remains outside the licensed conclusion. The topic-substitution check lowers no further: deleting this specific early-warning controller leaves only generic efficient reasoning and no comparable deployable handle.
